sentences.en: Our diplomacy and our military strategy were clearly in contradiction.
sentences.zh: 我们的外交和军事战略明显存在矛盾。

sentences.en: Our diplomacy and strategy ran in clear contradiction to each other.
sentences.zh: 我们的外交策略与整体策略明显相互抵触。

sentences.en: The strength of the firm is attributed to its future-oriented strategy.
sentences.zh: 公司的实力归功于其面向未来的战略。
